def nmse(f,p0,n=25):
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
    for s in range(n):
        x0=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.6*rng.standard_normal(len(p0))) if s else np.array(p0,float)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: (f(p)-y)/np.std(y),x0,max_nfev=2000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    return np.mean((f(best.x)-y)**2)/np.var(y), best.x

def equation(t, P, params):
